title: Chinese Cabbage Salad
description: A simple and crunchy salad recipe using Chinese cabbage, perfect for a quick lunch.
instructions: 1. Wash the Chinese cabbage and cut it into thin strips.
2. In a large bowl, combine the Chinese cabbage, salad seeds, salt, and pepper.
3. In a small bowl, whisk together the zesty dressing and 2 tablespoons of water.
4. Pour the dressing over the cabbage mixture and toss until well coated.
5. Chill the salad in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes.
6. Serve the salad cold, garnished with additional salad seeds if desired.
